title: Rental unit in Scottsdale · ★4.88 · 6 bedrooms · 12 beds · 3 baths
description:
Escape to this spacious 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom Scottsdale vacation home, just minutes from the energy and excitement of Old Town. Perfect for large families, group getaways, or golf retreats, this home offers a stylish and comfortable setting designed for both relaxation and connection.

 The space 
Inside, you’ll find a bright open-concept layout with inviting living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, and plenty of room for everyone to unwind. Each bedroom is thoughtfully furnished to ensure a restful stay, while three full bathrooms provide added convenience for groups.

Step outside to your private backyard oasis—featuring a sparkling pool, covered patio, BBQ grill, and cozy string lighting that sets the mood for evening gatherings under the desert sky.

Whether you're lounging poolside, exploring local dining and nightlife, or enjoying time together at home, this Scottsdale retreat is the perfect home base for your next memorable stay.

-----

Pool Heating*

‍There is an additional fee of $150 per night to heat up the swimming pool with a three night minimum.

House Rules: 
-No professional photo/video shoots unless approved.
-Occupancy is limited to the max amount of guests shown in the listing.
-A signed rental agreement is REQUIRED to book this home.‍
-No loud noise after 9pm. Violation of this rule will result in loss of security deposit and removal from the home without refund. 
-Must be at least 25 years old to book.
-Do not tape anything to the walls and/or ceilings.
-Guests will be charge for any and all damage in the home resulting from their stay.
-Per city requirements, maximum family size is restricted to 6 adults and their related dependent children, up to 18 guests total.
-Any items left behind can be sent back for a handling fee of $25 plus the cost to ship and must be prepared before the item will be sent.‍
